qualification: Actual unmodified/patched Timer implementation compiled against a small counting DisplayWindow stub; callbacks are counted but never invoked after deletion. This proves the source lifetime defect, not the origin of all retained native crashes.

reproduction.qualification: Counts registered callbacks without executing deleted objects. Source lifetime bug only; not proof of every native crash cause.

reports.qualification: Six local load attempts are a bounded diagnostic, not proof of stability or a production mitigation. A windowed request may match current launcher defaults.
